In current DBus interface:


As I thought it doesn't fit each other with DBus primitives, map vs vector with pairs.
> I changed this locally, and it compiles fine for me.

> As I thought it doesn't fit each other with DBus primitives, map vs vector with pairs.


On dbus, a "map" is actually an array (c++ vector) of struct (represented in c++ as a pair).  we represent them that way so we retain order, and avoid any extra sorting/hashing that isn't intended during the unpack (although we can sort if we choose).  Using the same types consistently also reduces the binary size.

This is why you're being asked to change.
